qwen_voices.M: Male, 20 years old, American. Low-mid pitch, warm clear steady voice, calm logical leader, quietly tense.
qwen_voices.B: Male, 19 years old, American nerd. Medium-low pitch, soft careful precise voice, anxious and breathy, slightly fast.
qwen_voices.L: Male, 20 years old, American. Medium pitched, nasal sarcastic tone, jokey but nervous, quick talker.
qwen_voices.A: Female, 30 years old, American flight attendant. Sweet, soft, sing-song airline announcement voice, far too calm and polite, a fixed smile in the voice.
qwen_voices.C: Male, 50 years old, American airline captain. Low, calm, flat intercom voice, slow and bored.
qwen_voices.G: Girl, 8 years old, American. Small, soft, sweet voice, calm and slow, slightly sing-song, unsettlingly polite.

lines.text: Two hundred and eleven. Two hundred and twelve. Two hundred and thirteen.
This plane only has two hundred and twelve seats.
So somebody's sitting on somebody's lap?
Every seat is full. Nobody's standing.
The man in twenty-two C. He hasn't moved since takeoff.
He's not breathing. Look at his chest.
And that kid has been drawing us. For three hours.
I'm drawing everyone on the plane.
She drew someone sitting between us. With no face.
Wait. I booked two seats. You and me.
Guys. Come on. I've always been here.
One of us isn't real. Pick wrong... and you become the extra passenger.
